title: abies lasiocarpa var. fallax
intro: Abies lasiocarpa var. fallax, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Douglas-fir, is a variant of the Douglas-fir tree, native to the western United States. This plant has been used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Abies lasiocarpa var. fallax include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, which can help relieve congestion and soothe muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, specifically borneol and bornyl acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
